theme: A clear day on the water, with next week's logistics to lock down.
greeting: The calendar's empty today, Dan — you're mid-charter on the Adriatic. The pressing things are bookings and one bit of prep, all best knocked out while you have signal on dry land.

needsAttention.title: Skim the NACD programming report before the committee call
needsAttention.detail: Larissa's reminder for tomorrow's 1:00 PM NACD New England programming committee call is in your inbox with the latest programming report attached — read it ahead so you arrive with a view.

needsAttention.title: Arrange the Sept 19 disembark logistics
needsAttention.detail: The charter ends at noon Saturday in Komolac. The transfer to the Remisens in Cavtat, an early Sunday checkout for the 7:30 AM flight, and a bag hold before 3 PM check-in all need arranging from land before Saturday, while connectivity holds.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 20 SUV and the St Pete gap nights
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sunday Sept 20 at 3:55 PM; the full-size SUV rental and the Sept 20–21 St Pete nights before the Orlando villa are both still unbooked. Also glance that the Sept 27–Oct 5 St Pete Airbnb converted to confirmed before its Sept 18 charge.

needsAttention.title: Hold a Christmas SUV out of Portland
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV from PWM over Christmas week is the tightest rental in that market and sells out early; a refundable hold now costs nothing and closes the risk.

inbox.noise: The rest is promotions — the NYT cookbook, an Expedia coupon, Indochino, a Freeport food truck, and the weekly no-bread note.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on a reply.

recipe.title: Borlotti beans with sautéed baby kale
recipe.why: Early-autumn cooking leans on fresh shell beans and the first tender greens of the season.

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar — you're out on the water in Croatia with the day your own.
Time ashore is best spent on the Saturday disembark logistics while you still have a signal.
Tomorrow's 1 PM NACD programming call is the one fixed point — the report is in your inbox to read ahead.
